description: This Swift source file defines a SpeechPipeline and related structures for processing audio input via speech recognition. It manages microphone input, converts audio formats, performs speech analysis and transcription, and streams recognized speech segments.

classes.name: SpeechSegment
classes.description: Implements a recognizable segment of speech, containing the transcribed text and a flag indicating if it's the final segment.

classes.name: SpeechPipelineError
classes.description: Defines errors that can occur within the SpeechPipeline, such as authorization denial, format unavailability, or transcriber unavailability.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: Manages the speech recognition process, including microphone input, audio format conversion, analysis, transcription, and streaming of speech segments.

methods.name: SpeechPipeline.start
methods.description: Starts the microphone input and begins capturing and transcribing speech into a stream of SpeechSegment objects.

methods.name: SpeechPipeline.stop
methods.description: Stops the audio input, finalizes transcription, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: SpeechPipeline.handleBuffer
methods.description: Converts audio buffers to the target format and feeds them into the analysis pipeline.

methods.name: SpeechPipeline.requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests user authorization for speech recognition if not already granted.
